view_cancel_leaves_deviceinfo_unchanged_: Cancel: leaves DeviceInfo unchanged, switches to EDL and automatically restores the original GPT, Recovery and vendor_boot.

view_closing_during_writes_can_leave_the: Closing during writes can leave the device unable to boot. Resume or restore may be required using the saved state and backup.

view_connect_the_backed_up_device_in: Connect the backed-up device in TWRP (ADB Recovery) or EDL.

view_encrypted_x_files_are_decrypted_to: Encrypted .x files are decrypted to XML in the selected folder.

view_firmware_flashing_in_progress_keep_: Firmware flashing in progress. Keep USB connected; each step advances automatically.
view_firmware_will_be_installed_again_an: Firmware will be installed again and user data will be erased.
view_firmware_writes_and_final_steps_are: Firmware writes and final steps are complete. Check actual device boot and country code.

To return to China firmware, flash it with this tool as well; otherwise OTA updates will not work normally.
view_install_udev_rules_for_usb_access: Install udev rules for USB access.
view_keep_the_tablet_connected_to_the: Keep the tablet connected to the PC by USB until the operation is complete. Do not unplug the cable or close this app.
view_keep_usb_connected_after_the_dump: Keep USB connected. After the dump is saved, the original configuration is restored automatically.
view_keep_usb_connected_each_step_advanc: Keep USB connected. Each step advances automatically.
view_live_logs_are_saved_automatically_k: Live logs are saved automatically. Keep the app open during writes.
view_no_additional_driver_is_required_on: No additional driver is required on this platform.
view_original_region_and_configuration_w: Original region and configuration were verified/restored, then system boot was requested. Check warnings and actual device boot.
view_preview_no_device_connections_or_fi: Preview · No device connections or file changes.

view_reboot_to_twrp_deviceinfo_is_read_2: Reboot to TWRP. DeviceInfo is read and backed up there, then you choose the values to change.
view_reboot_to_twrp_to_back_up: Reboot to TWRP to back up, update and verify DeviceInfo.
view_recheck_the_saved_twrp_deviceinfo_s: Recheck the saved TWRP/DeviceInfo stage, then restore original GPT/Recovery and install firmware.

view_review_the_saved_settings_and_curre: Review the saved settings and current stage.
view_saved_state_needs_attention_before_: Saved state needs attention before a new operation.
view_select_confirm_if_normal_boot_is: Select Confirm if normal boot is possible; otherwise select Cancel.

view_stock_firmware_could_not_be_verifie: Stock firmware could not be verified

view_the_device_must_be_able_to: The device must be able to boot normally before starting this operation.
view_the_driver_installer_is_running_ple: The driver installer is running. Please wait for it to finish.

view_these_missing_images_will_be_skippe: These missing images will be skipped:

From TWRP, the live DeviceInfo is read and written back to the complete original only when it holds this run's value, then original vendor_boot, Recovery and GPT are restored. Any other value stops without a write.
view_this_is_the_device_that_created: This is the device that created the backup; restore its original region and configuration.

This tool works by changing the device's own region.
When you later flash firmware with LTBox, choose the changed region in its 'Device region' option.
view_use_userspace_mode_on_this_platform: Use Userspace mode on this platform.

view_weighted_by_expected_work_firmware_: Weighted by expected work; firmware installation follows actual total transfer.
view_wrong_security_structure_values_can: Wrong security/structure values can stop the tablet from booting. Always review the change list before writing. Cancelling in the editor leaves DeviceInfo unchanged and restores the original configuration automatically.
wait_stop_the_operation_you_can_resume: Stop the operation? You can resume when ADB (TWRP) connects later, or enter EDL manually and restore the original backup.
